column1: # Included datasets. disease: SLE or SjD; each dataset brings its own healthy controls. doublets: the doublet design
# (pooled_cleared = pooled libraries whose cross-donor doublets the authors removed by demultiplexing; single = one donor
# per library or per deposited sample; removed_by_authors = deposited cells after the authors' doublet removal, so
# doublet detection is not run again). label: short name used in the code ("Perez" = GSE174188).
